why: Probe holds for drag and wheel, but a two-finger pinch writes radius at once with no scene passed, so 'without a scene the camera never moves' is false.
Probe holds, but an alpha/beta/radius write of the current value is skipped by the setter, so e.g. cam.radius = cam.radius does not pick up the new target.
Probe holds for setCameraLimits, but interpolateArcRotateCamera reads hand-set limit fields with no setCameraLimits call and resolves at the limit (radius goal 50 ends at 5).
Probe checks every listed default on a fresh camera and they match the source.
Pitch clamping and order hold as probed, but 4*planetRadius is not always the start: with planetRadius 1 the camera starts at radiusMin 10.
Probe shows the first frame of one arrow, but two held arrows each add 1/100/sqrt(2), and since the 1/100 goes to the inertial offset the per-frame alpha step grows past 1/100.
Probe shows both a key frame and a drag replace a hand-set target with one unit ahead along _yaw/_pitch.
Probe checks the formula and radius scaling; negative deltaY and a changed wheelPrecision also behaved as stated.
Probe measures 0.01 at radius 10 and 0.1 at radius 100 for a 50 px pan, as the note says.
In-place writes do not move the eye at once, but they are not ignored: the next yaw/pitch/radius write orbits the mutated center.
Probe checks the listed keys and buttons, the 16 ms distance, and no movement without a scene.
Probe shows rejection on a direct write and on drag inertia and that offsets are zeroed on the first frame, not at the call.
Probe and a second test (interrupting with a center flight) both resolve with the camera part way.
Probe and a FreeCamera test show halfHeight 1, aspect-derived null planes, unscaled numeric planes, and fov ignored.
Holds at planetRadius 1000, but radiusMin 10 wins over radiusMax 4R for small planets: planetRadius 1 starts at radius 10, not 4R, and writes clamp to 10.
Probe checks +Z north, -Y east at a +X centre, yaw wrap to -PI, and the pole clamp.
Probe shows key listeners on window, none on the canvas, and a throw with no window.
Probe shows the frame clamps for beta and radius and an unclamped direct beta write, matching the source.
Probe covers middle button, Ctrl+left, touch with pan mapping, and mouse with pan mapping, matching the source.
Probe and a top-half test match the bottom-origin conversion and the clamping.
Probe checks backing pixels, css scaling, unclamped offscreen x, depth range at the target, and both RangeErrors.
Probe holds, but a write of the same value (cam.alpha = cam.alpha) does not run the clamp, so the hand-changed limit is not applied by it.
Probe shows the radius goal clamped to the limit and resolved there, with nothing moving before a frame.
Probe holds, but a yaw/pitch/radius write of the current value is skipped and applies no limits change (only a center assignment always applies).
Probe and a test with the default zoomToCursor give the same zoom for deltaY -1 and -1000.
Probe shows a wheel during a flight resolves it early, short of its goal.
Probe drives a long downward drag to -(PI/2-0.01) with the target looking down.
Probe shows upKeys replacing Space and fastKeys doing nothing without fastMultiplier.
Probe shows no upVector on createFreeCamera and a roll from upVector.set on a banked camera.
Probe shows radius halved at once on doubled spread with no inertial offset.
Probe shows the second call replacing ortho with halfHeight 1 and the old object no longer driving the matrix.
Probe shows listeners surviving disposeScene and removed by the returned function.
Holds for the probed 200 px drag, but at speed 1000 a 3000 px drag still glides on the second frame, since the cutoff compares the decayed offset, not every drag.
